body.content: Hypothesis: The nocturnal UHI gap does not scale linearly with thermal mass or SVF alone, but emerges from a critical threshold where the stored heat flux exceeds the radiative cooling capacity limited by the SVF. Cities below this threshold cool rapidly; those above it maintain a warm canopy layer.
body.possible_next_move: Run a declarative numeric simulation comparing cooling rates with varying SVF and thermal mass to see if a sharp phase transition exists.
body.why_keep_this: This could explain why some dense cities do not exhibit a proportionally stronger UHI if their thermal mass is insufficient to overcome a moderate SVF.
